agents.reason: No agent loop in LLMville: residents are other players and LLM bots driven through the agent REST API, nothing runs needs, thoughts or mood on a world clock.

audio-probe.reason: LLMville has no audio mix at all: the miniature lab plays no music, ambience or sound effects, so there is no bus to read.

cover-field.reason: Cover does not exist in LLMville: it is a cosy lab tycoon with no combat, no threats and nothing that takes cover.

cover-points-from-solids.reason: No cover positions in LLMville: racks and desks are build pieces, not combat cover, because the game has no fighting.

cover-points-near.reason: No nearest-cover query in LLMville: nobody is shot at in the shared lab world, so cover is never searched for.

cover-score.reason: No threat scoring of cover in LLMville: the co-op lab game has no enemies or threats to score cover against.

cover-select.reason: No cover selection in LLMville: there are no combat roles, flanks or ranges in a model-training tycoon.

damage-runtime.reason: No damage table in LLMville: nothing has health or takes hits; the risk in the game is money and overdue bills, not damage.

damage-target-unknown.reason: No damage table in LLMville, and no hit targets: without combat there are no resistance or armor profiles for a hit to miss.

equipment-slot-inventory.reason: No worn gear in LLMville: the player inventory holds lab hardware to place (GPUs, racks, decor), not equipment slots on a body.

game-save.reason: No client save document in LLMville: each world's labs, racks, models and wallet live in Convex tables on the server, written by authenticated mutations.

game-save-digest.reason: No save document to hash in LLMville: persistence is server-side Convex rows per world, not one versioned client save to digest.

loan-schedule.reason: No loans in LLMville: players pay utility bills with late fees but never borrow, so no repayment schedule exists.

loans.reason: No loans in LLMville, and no borrowing: money comes only from serving trained models and goes to hardware, upgrades and bills; there is no loan to draw or default.

loot-comparison.reason: No loot rolling in LLMville, and no rolled items: store hardware has fixed catalog stats, so there are no random rolls to compare.

loot-generation.reason: No loot rolling in LLMville: hardware is bought from a fixed store catalog; nothing drops or rolls affixes.

loot-roller.reason: No loot rolling in LLMville, and no drop tables: the game has no enemies or chests, items come only from the hardware store.

loot-score.reason: No loot rolling in LLMville, and no loot stat scoring: hardware stats are catalog constants (TFLOPs, VRAM, power), not rolled stat blocks.

loot-validation.reason: No loot rolling in LLMville, and no rolled-item catalog to validate: the only items are fixed store hardware and decorations.

mission-events.reason: No mission runtime in LLMville: there are no kills or failure events; progress is income and model quality, not missions.

mission-rewards.reason: No mission runtime in LLMville, and no mission payouts: rewards come from serving models over time, not from completing objectives.

mission-runtime.reason: No mission runtime in LLMville, and no missions: the loop is build, train, serve and expand in a persistent world, with a tutorial but no objective state machine.

mission-validation.reason: No mission runtime in LLMville, and no mission objectives to validate: the onboarding tutorial is a step list, not counted objective kinds.

mount-game.reason: No game host in LLMville, and no GameHost mount: it is a TanStack Router web app with accounts, menus and a Convex-backed session route, mounting its own React Three Fiber scene.

nav-crowd.reason: No navigation in LLMville, and no nav-mesh crowd: avatars are steered directly by players or bots with walk-and-collide movement, never routed as a crowd.

nav-runtime.reason: No navigation routing in LLMville: there are no AI walkers that need paths; players walk the lab themselves.

navmesh-from-scene.reason: No navigation in LLMville, and no baked nav mesh: the world is tiled player-built plots with no editor-authored nav data or pathing agents.

near-agents.reason: No agent loop in LLMville, and no on-screen resident crowd: every avatar in the lab world is a connected player or an API-driven bot, so there are no needs-driven residents.

offscreen-world.reason: No offscreen simulation in LLMville, and no offscreen agent simulation: income accrues server-side from serving state, and there are no far-away agents to keep cheap.

perception-service.reason: No perception in LLMville: nothing sees, hears or remembers the player; there are no guards or creatures.

police-response.reason: No police heat in LLMville: a cosy lab tycoon has no crimes, witnesses or wanted level.

police-roads.reason: No police heat in LLMville, and no roadblocks: the world has no roads, lane graph or police, only player lab plots.

ride-appeal.reason: No ride simulation in LLMville, and no rides: it is an AI-lab tycoon, not a theme park; guests and ride ratings do not exist.

ride-choice.reason: No ride simulation in LLMville, and no guests choosing rides: the only things people use are the players' own GPU racks and lab props.

ride-sim.reason: No ride simulation in LLMville: racks train and serve models, but there are no ride cycles, queues or breakdowns.

run-loop.reason: No runs in LLMville: a world is persistent and shared, with no start, bank-or-lose or reset between attempts.

rvo-avoidance.reason: No crowd steering in LLMville: a handful of player and bot avatars walk with solid-obstacle collision, not reciprocal avoidance.

session-loop.reason: No run in LLMville, and no session settle: players drop in and out of a persistent shared world and keep everything; nothing is settled at session end.

skill-tree.reason: No skill tree in LLMville: progression is buying hardware, unlocking store tiers and training better models, not spending points on a tree.

squad-combat.reason: No squad combat in LLMville: co-op means sharing a lab world and chat, never fighting together.

status-runtime.reason: No status effects in LLMville: there is no burn, slow or shock; nothing in the lab has ticking conditions.

status-unknown.reason: No status ids in LLMville to reject: the game defines no status effects because it has no combat.

supply-demand-pricing.reason: No market pricing in LLMville, and no stock-priced goods market: store hardware has fixed prices; serving income is shaped by a frontier benchmark and daily market modifier on the server, not finite stock.

traffic.reason: No traffic in LLMville: there are no roads or cars in the lab world.

transaction-ledger.reason: No minor-unit transaction ledger in LLMville: balances are Convex wallet rows changed by gameplay mutations; there is no per-account money-movement log to keep.

utility-brain.reason: No agent loop in LLMville, and no utility-brain decisions: bots choose actions from an external LLM over the agent API, not from decaying-need appeal curves.

vehicle-damage.reason: No vehicle damage in LLMville, and no vehicles: players walk around the shared lab world, nothing is driven or crashed.

visitor-population.reason: No park population in LLMville, and no park visitors: the only people in the world are signed-in players and their bots.

wait-queue.reason: No physical waiting line in LLMville: training jobs queue on hardware, but no bodies stand in a line with a measured throughput.

weapon-system.reason: No weapon runtime in LLMville, and no weapons: it is a peaceful co-op AI-lab tycoon with nothing to fire or reload.
